description: Schedule a one-shot timer in the active project (or specified scope). Pass either fire_at (absolute epoch-ms) or delay_ms (relative from now), not both. When the timer fires the shell emits an OS notification; if agent_id is set, an entry also lands in that agent's inbox (delivered on its next tool call, 24h TTL).

agent_id.description: Registered agent id to deliver an inbox event to on fire.

delay_ms.description: Fire delay from now, ms. Mutually exclusive with fire_at.

fire_at.description: Absolute fire time, unix epoch ms. Mutually exclusive with delay_ms.

name: iyke_timer_schedule
